Jenkins Gatling Plugin 136.vb_9009b_3d33a_e serves Gatling reports in a manner that bypasses the Content-Security-Policy protection introduced in Jenkins 1.641 and 1.625, resulting in a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by users able to change report content.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins Gatling Plugin: affected 136.vb_9009b_3d33a_e

Jenkins OpenId Connect Authentication Plugin 4.452.v2849b_d3945fa_ and earlier, except 4.438.440.v3f5f201de5dc, treats usernames as case-insensitive, allowing attackers on Jenkins instances configured with a case-sensitive OpenID Connect provider to log in as any user by providing a username that differs only in letter case, potentially gaining administrator access to Jenkins.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins OpenId Connect Authentication Plugin: unaffected 4.453.v4d7765c854f4 <* (maven); unaffected 4.438.440.v3f5f201de5dc

References:
- https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2025-01-22/#SECURITY-3461 [vendor-advisory]

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In jenkins/ssh-agent Docker images 6.11.1 and earlier, SSH host keys are generated on image creation for images based on Debian, causing all containers based on images of the same version use the same SSH host keys, allowing attackers able to insert themselves into the network path between the SSH client (typically the Jenkins controller) and SSH build agent to impersonate the latter.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins jenkins/ssh-agent Docker images: affected 0 <=6.11.1 (maven)

References:
- https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2025-04-10/#SECURITY-3565 [vendor-advisory]

### CVE-2025-67635
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2025-12-10 | Updated: 2025-12-16 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-404 CWE-404 Improper Resource Shutdown or Release
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

Jenkins 2.540 and earlier, LTS 2.528.2 and earlier does not properly close HTTP-based CLI connections when the connection stream becomes corrupted, allowing unauthenticated attackers to cause a denial of service.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins: unaffected 2.541 <* (maven); unaffected 2.528.3 <2.528.* (maven)

Credits: Camilo Vera Vidales (https://www.linkedin.com/in/camilo-vera-vidales/)

References:
- https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2025-12-10/#SECURITY-3630 [vendor-advisory]

### CVE-2025-67641
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2025-12-10 | Updated: 2025-12-10 | Max CVSS: 8
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Jenkins Coverage Plugin 2.3054.ve1ff7b_a_a_123b_ and earlier does not validate the configured coverage results ID when creating coverage results, only when submitting the job configuration through the UI, allowing attackers with Item/Configure permission to use a `javascript:` scheme URL as identifier by configuring the job through the REST API, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins Coverage Plugin: affected 0 <=2.3054.ve1ff7b_a_a_123b_ (maven)

References:
- https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2025-12-10/#SECURITY-3611 [vendor-advisory]
